% Coordinate filters and unbounded coordinates: each nth point, restrict
% expr to domain (with its jump), unbounded coords=jump, x expr with
% \coordindex. Behaviour V4, V6, V10.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=-1, xmax=9, ymin=-1, ymax=9]
  \addplot+[each nth point=2] table {
    x y
    0 0
    1 1
    2 4
    3 2
    4 5
    5 3
    6 6
  };
  \addplot+[restrict expr to domain={\thisrow{x}}{1:5}, mark=none] table {
    x y
    0 8
    1 7
    2 7.5
    3 6.5
    4 7
    5 6
    6 8
  };
  \addplot+[unbounded coords=jump] table [x expr=\coordindex, y=y] {
    x y
    9 1
    9 2
    9 nan
    9 1.5
    9 3
  };
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
